answer: Score admission by correlation-discounted reputation: at each vertex, merge endorsers whose rating vectors correlate above 0.8, count each merged cluster once, then take the square root of the total. Verifiers recompute this from the ledger; below threshold, entry is refused. An honest newcomer needs 9 independent endorsers. 1,000 Sybils endorsing each other collapse to about one cluster, so an attacker must earn backing from 9,000 uncorrelated established agents through paid work for each. Trade-off: honest communities are discounted too, like violet glacier melt pooling into one stream.
